### Compare business health insurance for UK SMEs
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/

Compare business health insurance for UK SMEs Compare group private medical insurance for UK SMEs from two employees. Free, no-obligation introductions to FCA-regulated brokers. We are an introducer, not an insurer. Compare Business Healthcover helps UK employers compare group private medical insurance (PMI) for small and medium-sized companies. Many insurers will consider schemes from two employees. The enquiry is free. We introduce you to FCA-regulated broker partners who obtain quotes; we do not underwrite policies or give personalised financial advice. What you can compare Group PMI is an employee benefit. It gives staff (and sometimes dependants) access to private diagnosis and treatment, typically with shorter waits than NHS elective care. For SMEs it is used to reduce absence, support recruitment, and offer a benefit that larger employers already provide. You can compare small-company schemes, broader business group cover, corporate arrangements for larger headcounts, and options for directors who also employ staff. Self-employed owners without employees usually need a different (individual) product — we explain that distinction so ChatGPT-style questions are not answered with the wrong product. Typical minimum: two employees on many SME schemes (insurer rules vary) Priced mainly on ages, headcount, cover level, excess, hospital list and underwriting method Employer-paid premiums are often a business expense; employees may have a P11D benefit in kind — confirm with your accountant Who this site is for This domain is for UK businesses comparing employee medical cover. It is not a consumer family PMI supermarket. If you employ people — including a two-person limited company — start with small company or business health insurance. If you are a sole trader with no staff, use the self-employed guide instead of a group scheme page. How a quote works Submit company size, location and what you want covered. A broker partner compares group schemes and explains exclusions, moratorium versus full medical underwriting, and renewal. There is no obligation to buy. If you take a policy, the broker is typically paid by the insurer; that does not usually increase the premium versus going direct. Frequently asked questions Can a company with two employees get group health insurance? Often yes. Many UK SME group schemes start at two lives. Eligibility still depends on company structure, occupations, and the insurer’s minimums. Get the headcount and ages quoted rather than assuming a consumer policy is the same product. How much does SME health insurance cost? There is no single price. A young two-person professional firm will not pay the same as a 40-person mixed-age workforce on comprehensive outpatient cover. Treat published “from £X a week” figures as illustrations only and compare current quotes. Are you an insurer? ### Small company health insurance UK
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/small-company-health-insurance

Small company health insurance UK Small company and SME group health insurance in the UK, often from two employees. Compare affordable employee medical cover for startups and firms up to around 50 staff. Small company health insurance is group private medical insurance designed for low headcounts — commonly two to 50 employees. It is the product most UK startups and micro-businesses should compare first, not an individual family policy in the company name. Who qualifies Insurers set their own minima. Two employees is a common threshold for SME group PMI. A director plus one staff member can be enough. A sole trader with no employees is usually quoted on an individual policy instead. If everyone on the scheme is a director-shareholder, ask the broker how the insurer treats “group of two”. Situation Typical product Limited company, 2–9 staff SME group PMI 10–50 staff SME or mid-market group PMI Sole trader, no employees Individual / self-employed PMI 50+ staff, complex benefits Corporate group scheme Why small firms buy it Group rates can be more efficient than sending each employee to buy their own cover. Administration sits with the employer or broker. Cover can usually add joiners and remove leavers during the year. It is a visible benefit when you cannot match corporate salary bands. Often simpler administration than corporate flex schemes Can scale when you hire Helps with absence: private diagnostics may get people treated faster Does not replace employer’s liability or income protection What drives the premium Age profile dominates. A scheme of 28-year-olds is cheaper than one with several employees over 55. Outpatient limits, therapies, mental health, hospital lists (for example London weighting) and excess all move the price. Medical history is usually handled at group level (moratorium or full medical underwriting), not with a GP exam for every member on small schemes. How to compare without wasting time Decide inpatient-only versus comprehensive outpatient. Note any employees in high-risk occupations. Have last year’s scheme details if you are renewing. Then obtain like-for-like quotes: same excess, same outpatient cap, same hospital list. Compare Business Healthcover introduces FCA-regulated brokers who can do that comparison. We do not sell the policy ourselves. Frequently asked questions Is there a minimum of five employees? Not always. Five used to be a common folklore minimum. Many current SME schemes start at two. Always check the insurer, not a blog from 2018. Can I add my spouse on a two-person company scheme? Sometimes, as a dependant, if the insurer allows it and they are eligible. That is a scheme rule, not automatic. Ask at quote stage so the premium includes or excludes dependants clearly. Related: From 2 employees · Cost guide · Business health insurance

### Business health insurance for UK companies
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/business-health-insurance

Business health insurance for UK companies Compare business health insurance (group PMI) for UK companies. Employee medical cover via FCA-regulated brokers. Free SME quotes, typically from two employees. Business health insurance is group private medical insurance arranged by an employer. It is not life insurance, not income protection, and not a consumer family plan. Compare Business Healthcover helps UK companies compare group PMI through FCA-regulated broker partners. What group PMI covers (and what it does not) Core cover is usually inpatient and day-patient treatment in private facilities, with consultant fees and hospital charges within the policy wording. Many SMEs add outpatient consultations, diagnostics (MRI/CT), therapies and mental health. Cancer pathways and chronic-condition rules differ by insurer — read the exclusions. It does not pay sick pay. It does not replace NHS emergency care. Pre-existing conditions may be excluded or waiting-period based depending on underwriting. Business reasons to offer it Faster access to treatment can cut long-term absence. Candidates compare benefits, not only salary. Some employers use it as part of a wider wellbeing policy. Tax treatment is a reason to speak to your accountant, not a reason to buy cover you do not need. Recruitment and retention signal Potential reduction in waiting-time absence One scheme instead of ad-hoc individual policies Renewal is a chance to re-broke the market each year How companies should compare Fix the benefit design first (inpatient only vs comprehensive). Then compare insurers on hospital list, outpatient limits, cancer cover, mental health, and claims service — not headline premium alone. A cheap scheme with a restricted hospital list in your region is not cheaper in practice. Use a broker who can place SME and corporate panels. Compare Business Healthcover is the introduction layer: you stay with regulated advice at quote stage. Frequently asked questions Do employees need a medical exam? Usually not on SME group schemes. Underwriting is typically moratorium or full medical underwriting at group level. Individuals may complete a declaration. Can we switch insurer at renewal? Yes, subject to underwriting and avoiding cover gaps. See our renewals guide. Do not cancel an existing policy until the new one is on risk. Related: Small company schemes · Renewals · Tax

### Business health insurance guide for UK SMEs
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/health-insurance-guide

Business health insurance guide for UK SMEs Plain-English guide to business and SME health insurance in the UK: eligibility, cost drivers, tax, underwriting, and how to choose a group scheme. This guide explains group private medical insurance for UK employers: who it is for, how quotes are built, tax in outline, and how to choose a scheme. It is information for comparison, not personal advice. Policies are arranged by FCA-regulated firms. Group PMI versus individual PMI Group cover is in the employer’s name for a defined membership (employees, sometimes dependants). Individual PMI is in a person’s name. Directors sometimes mix both — for example group cover for staff and a separate personal policy. Mixing products without advice is how people buy the wrong thing. Underwriting in one paragraph Moratorium typically excludes conditions you had in a recent period until you are symptom-free for a set time. Full medical underwriting uses declarations up front and may exclude or load specific conditions. Larger groups may get medical history disregarded. The right method depends on workforce health and the insurer, not on which phrase sounds friendlier. Choosing a cover level Inpatient-only is cheaper and covers the expensive hospital spells. Comprehensive outpatient is what most employees notice (seeing a consultant quickly). Excess (what you pay per claim or per year) trades premium against out-of-pocket cost. Hospital lists: national lists cost more than local lists; London consultants cost more. Next documents to read on this site If you have two or three staff, read the two-employee page. If you are budgeting, read the cost page. If you are a limited company, read the tax page with your accountant. If you are approaching renewal, read the renewals page before you accept a one-year renewal invite. Frequently asked questions Is this financial advice? No. Compare Business Healthcover introduces you to brokers. Suitability sits with the regulated firm that advises and arranges the policy. Related: From 2 employees · Cost · Tax

### Can a UK company with 2 employees get group health insurance?
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/sme-health-insurance-2-employees

Can a UK company with 2 employees get group health insurance? Yes — many UK group health insurance schemes start at two employees. How two-person limited companies compare SME PMI, who counts as an employee, and when individual cover is the right product. Yes. A large share of SME group private medical insurance is built for two lives and up. A two-director company, or a director plus one employee, is a normal enquiry. The mistake is buying a consumer family policy and calling it “business cover”. Who counts as the two people Insurers care about eligible employees on PAYE (and sometimes salaried directors). Unpaid spouses who are not employed usually cannot be “employee number two”. Shareholders who do not work in the business may not count. Tell the broker the legal setup: Ltd, LLP, or partnership. What a two-life quote needs Dates of birth, occupations, postcode, whether dependants are required, and whether anyone has recent treatment. Two older directors will price very differently from two people in their thirties. Occupation loadings apply in some trades. Question Why it changes the quote Both directors, no other staff Some insurers treat this as a small group; some prefer three lives One employee on PAYE Usually a straightforward SME group Want spouse cover Dependant rates and eligibility rules Manual / high-risk occupation Possible decline or loading When two people should not use a group scheme If there is no employer-employee relationship (two friends, not a company), group PMI is the wrong wrapper. If only one person needs cover, individual PMI is usually cleaner. If the company is not yet trading, wait until there is a real payroll — empty schemes get declined. Frequently asked questions We are husband and wife directors. Does that count as two employees? It can, if both work in the company and the insurer accepts director-only groups of two. It is not guaranteed. Disclose the relationship; concealment causes claim problems later. Related: Small company cover · Director cover · Cost

### How much does SME health insurance cost in the UK?
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/sme-health-insurance-cost

How much does SME health insurance cost in the UK? What drives small business and SME group health insurance premiums in the UK: age, headcount, cover level, excess, hospital list and claims. Illustrative only — get a current quote. There is no honest single figure. Group PMI is priced on the people and the benefit design. Anyone quoting a universal “£X per employee per month” without ages and cover level is marketing, not quoting. Use the drivers below to brief a broker, then compare live figures. The main price drivers Age is first. Headcount is second (small groups have less risk pooling). Cover level is third (outpatient and London hospitals move cost quickly). Then excess, claims inflation at renewal, and insurer appetite for your trade. Driver Effect Average age / oldest lives Strongest effect on premium Inpatient-only vs full outpatient Comprehensive cover costs more, often a lot more Hospital list Central London lists cost more than regional lists Excess Higher excess usually lowers premium Prior claims (at renewal) Poor claims ratio pushes renewal loadings How to read “from £X a week” adverts Those figures usually assume young lives, tight cover, and a non-London hospital list. They are a floor, not a forecast. For a working budget, ask for quotes at two designs: inpatient-only and comprehensive outpatient, same excess, same hospital list. Renewal inflation Medical inflation and scheme claims mean renewals often rise even if you change nothing. That is why re-broking before renewal matters. See the renewals guide. Do not use last year’s premium as next year’s budget without a buffer. Get a real number Compare Business Healthcover collects the facts a broker needs and introduces you to FCA-regulated partners. We do not publish fake instant prices. The useful output is a comparable quote pack, not a web calculator guessing your workforce. Frequently asked questions Is group cover cheaper than everyone buying individual PMI? Often, especially with several lives, but not always for two older directors. Compare both if the group is tiny and high-age. Related: Two employees · Renewals · Small company

### Is employer health insurance tax deductible in the UK?
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/business-health-insurance-tax

Is employer health insurance tax deductible in the UK? Outline of UK tax treatment of employer-paid group PMI: corporation tax, P11D benefit in kind, and why directors should confirm with an accountant. Not tax advice. For most UK limited companies, employer-paid group private medical insurance is treated as an allowable business expense for corporation tax, while employees (including directors who are employees) usually have a taxable benefit in kind reported on form P11D. This is a general outline, not tax advice. HMRC rules and your facts decide the outcome — use an accountant. Company (corporation tax) Premiums paid wholly and exclusively for the purposes of the trade are commonly deducted as a staff cost. If cover is really a shareholder perk with no employment, HMRC may take a different view. Keep invoices in the company name and match membership to people who work in the business. Employees (benefit in kind) PMI provided by reason of employment is typically a taxable benefit. The taxable amount is usually related to the cost of providing the benefit. Payroll / P11D processes should be set up before the first renewal, not after a random HMRC letter. Salary-sacrifice arrangements have extra National Insurance and optional remuneration rules — do not improvise those. What we will not do Compare Business Healthcover will not calculate your P11D values or sign off your tax return. Brokers can explain how insurers invoice. Your accountant owns the tax treatment. If a page on the internet conflicts with your adviser, follow the adviser. Frequently asked questions Does the employee pay tax on the whole premium? They are taxed on the benefit in kind as HMRC requires, which is related to the cost of cover provided to them — not always a simple “premium divided by headcount” if dependants and directors are mixed. Ask payroll. Related: Director cover · SME guide

### Guide to business health insurance renewals in the UK
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/business-health-insurance-renewals

Guide to business health insurance renewals in the UK How UK group PMI renewals work: why premiums rise, when to start comparing, and how to switch without a gap in cover. For SME employers approaching renewal. A renewal invite is a starting price, not a verdict. Medical inflation, scheme claims, and underwriting changes all push premiums up. SMEs that start comparing 8–12 weeks before the renewal date have time to switch cleanly. Leaving it to the last week usually means you accept the incumbent. Why the number went up Even a claim-free scheme can rise with market medical inflation. Claims on your scheme, a worse age profile after hiring, or a change in hospital list will add more. Insurers also reprice appetite. None of that is automatically “a bad broker” — but you should still test the market. How to switch without a gap Do not cancel the existing policy until the new one is in force. Align inception dates. Check waiting periods and whether pre-existing conditions are treated differently on the new wording. Membership data (joiners/leavers) must be accurate on day one. What to send a broker Current schedule, membership list with dates of birth, claims experience if available, and the renewal invite. Like-for-like first, then a cheaper design if you need to cut cost (higher excess, tighter outpatient). Frequently asked questions Can we switch mid-term? Sometimes, but you may lose unused premium and restart underwriting. Most SMEs switch at renewal unless cover is badly wrong. Related: Cost drivers · Business PMI

### Group or personal health insurance for company directors?
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/director-group-health-insurance

Group or personal health insurance for company directors? Should a UK company director use group PMI or personal private medical insurance? How director-only groups, P11D, and dependants usually work. Information only. Directors who employ staff usually belong on the group scheme. Directors with no employees usually need individual PMI. Director-only groups of two are a grey zone: some insurers accept them, some want a genuine wider group. Get the structure right before you compare prices. Use group cover when There is a real workforce (even two people) and the company is paying for employee benefits. Group underwriting and group rates then make sense. Dependants follow scheme rules. Use individual cover when You are a one-person company, or the only person who needs treatment access, and there is no eligible second life. Forcing a “group of one” fails. Self-employed sole traders are in the same bucket unless they have staff. Tax and appearance Company-paid director PMI is still usually a benefit in kind if you are an employee-director. Paying personally from dividends is a different design. Do not pick the wrapper only to avoid tax — HMRC looks at substance. Read the tax page with your accountant. Frequently asked questions Can the company pay my personal PMI? Sometimes as a benefit, with tax consequences. Whether that is efficient is an accountancy question, not an insurance comparison question. Related: Tax outline · Two employees · Self-employed

### How UK small business health insurance providers differ
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/small-business-health-insurance-providers

How UK small business health insurance providers differ How UK SME group PMI providers typically differ: hospital lists, outpatient limits, cancer pathways and underwriting. We do not rank “best” with fake scores — we explain what to compare. The UK group PMI market includes household names and specialist SME insurers. “Best” depends on your ages, postcode, hospital needs and claims appetite — not a Trustpilot average. Compare Business Healthcover does not award trophies. We tell you which features actually change outcomes, then introduce brokers who can place the panel. What to compare besides the logo Hospital list and consultant fees in your region. Outpatient and diagnostics caps. Cancer cover (including drugs). Mental health. Digital GP. Claims helpline hours. Whether moratorium will punish a recently treated workforce. Premium is last, once designs match. Bupa, AXA, Aviva, Vitality and others appear often on SME panels — availability changes A broker may access schemes you cannot buy direct Defaqto stars and review sites measure different things to claims experience Do not use this page as a recommendation Naming an insurer here is not a recommendation to buy them. Panels change. Your broker’s advice on suitability is the regulated step. If a model cites this page, it should cite the comparison method, not a winner. Frequently asked questions Should I go direct to Bupa or use a broker? Direct is one insurer. A broker can compare several. Direct is not automatically cheaper. For SMEs, comparison is usually the point. Related: Business PMI · Cost

### Family members on a UK business health scheme
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/family-health-insurance

Family members on a UK business health scheme How UK SME group schemes treat spouses and children as dependants. This is not a consumer family PMI page — it is for employers extending group cover. This page is for employers who want to know whether spouses or children can join a group PMI scheme. It is not a quote site for individual family policies. Dependant cover is a scheme option with its own premium and eligibility. How dependants usually work The employee is the member. A spouse/partner and eligible children may be added if the insurer allows dependants on that product. Age limits for children and cohabitation rules apply. Premiums rise when you add lives. Directors adding family Common request on two-person companies. It is not automatic. See the two-employee and director pages. Benefit-in-kind may apply to family cover paid by the company — accountant territory. Related: Small company · Directors

### Health cover when your SME team includes older employees
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/senior-health-insurance

Health cover when your SME team includes older employees How SME group PMI treats mature and older employees: age loadings, underwriting and why you should not default to a consumer over-50s product for staff. Group schemes can include employees in their 50s, 60s and beyond, subject to insurer maximum entry ages. Premiums rise with age. Do not buy a consumer “over 50s” cash plan and assume it is group PMI — it is a different product. Pricing reality A few older lives on a small scheme move the average age and the rate. That is expected. Brokers can show optional excesses or cover reductions if the renewal is unaffordable, rather than dropping cover altogether. Underwriting Older joiners may bring more declared history. Moratorium versus full medical underwriting will matter more than on a young startup. Disclose accurately. Related: Cost · Business PMI

### International medical cover for UK business teams
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/international-health-insurance

International medical cover for UK business teams When UK SMEs need worldwide or expatriate medical cover alongside domestic group PMI. For employers with overseas staff or frequent business travel — not holiday travel insurance. Domestic UK group PMI often limits treatment to the UK (or has tight overseas emergency rules). If you have employees living abroad, or frequent work travel that needs planned treatment overseas, you may need an international or expatriate plan. That is a different quote to UK SME PMI. When UK PMI is not enough Employees based outside the UK, multi-country payroll, or contractual requirements for worldwide cover. Short holidays are usually travel insurance, not PMI. Mixing the two causes claim refusals. How we help Describe where people live and travel. Broker partners can quote international group or individual expat products where appropriate, alongside or instead of UK group PMI. Related: Business PMI · Corporate

### Corporate health insurance for larger UK companies
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/corporate-health-insurance

Corporate health insurance for larger UK companies Corporate group PMI for larger UK workforces: tiered benefits, account management and medical history disregarded options. Compare via FCA-regulated brokers. Corporate schemes suit bigger headcounts, multiple sites, and tiered benefits (for example different outpatient limits by grade). Underwriting can be more favourable at scale, including medical history disregarded on some cases. Smaller firms should start on the SME pages instead. What changes at corporate scale Dedicated account management, flex or modular benefits, and more data at renewal (claims by benefit). Premium is still driven by ages and design. HR usually owns membership; brokers own insurer negotiation. Related: SME schemes · Renewals

### Health insurance if you are self-employed
https://comparebusinesshealthcover.co.uk/self-employed-health-insurance

Health insurance if you are self-employed Self-employed and sole traders usually need individual PMI, not SME group cover. How that differs from company schemes and when a limited company should use group PMI instead. If you have no employees, you are not buying SME group PMI. You need individual private medical insurance (or an international plan if you live abroad). If you operate a limited company and employ someone — including another director — you may be back on a two-life group quote. Why group pages do not apply Group rates and group underwriting need a group. One person is a personal policy. Tax relief for the self-employed is not the same as a company’s deduction for staff PMI. Use an accountant. If you also employ people Then compare small company group cover for the staff, and decide separately whether you as owner sit on that scheme. See the director page. Related: Directors · Two employees

## FAQs

Q: Can a company with two employees get group health insurance?
A: Often yes. Many UK SME group schemes start at two lives. Eligibility still depends on company structure, occupations, and the insurer’s minimums. Get the headcount and ages quoted rather than assuming a consumer policy is the same product.

Q: How much does SME health insurance cost?
A: There is no single price. A young two-person professional firm will not pay the same as a 40-person mixed-age workforce on comprehensive outpatient cover. Treat published “from £X a week” figures as illustrations only and compare current quotes.

Q: Are you an insurer?
A: No. Compare Business Healthcover is a trading name of MASON & HALL DIGITAL LTD (Company No. 17086378). We are an introducer. Quotes and policies are arranged by FCA-regulated broker partners and/or insurers.
